text.bookpaste.config.title: BookPaste Settings
text.bookpaste.config.mode.label: Formatting mode
text.bookpaste.config.mode.smart_fill.de: Fills the page as much as possible and moves only the leftover tail to the next page.
text.bookpaste.config.mode.whole_paragra: Moves the next paragraph to a new page if it does not fully fit. Only splits a paragraph when a single paragraph is longer than one page.
text.bookpaste.config.hotkey.label: Quick toggle hotkey
text.bookpaste.config.hotkey.listening: Press a key or mouse button...
text.bookpaste.sign.partial: The sign is full. %s characters remain in the clipboard. About %s more %s needed.
text.bookpaste.sign.nospace: There is no space left on this sign. About %s more %s needed.
text.bookpaste.config.pages.description: Allows more than 100 pages only when the server confirms support. Singleplayer and BookPaste servers support this. Without confirmation the limit stays at 100 pages. Keep BookPaste installed to load unsigned books over 100 pages.
text.bookpaste.config.max_pages.label: Page limit:
text.bookpaste.config.max_pages.descript: 100 is the default; 0 means no limit. Changes apply to singleplayer.
text.bookpaste.config.pages.heading: Book page settings
text.bookpaste.config.pages.help_server: Server settings are shown when connected.
text.bookpaste.config.max_pages.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 2147483647.
text.bookpaste.config.max_pages.server_d: Controlled by the server. You cannot change this value here. 0 means no limit.
